title: Microplastics in river water: occurrence, weathering, and adsorption behaviour
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00614G, Paper
Bishwatma Biswas, Anuja Joseph, Sudha Goel
Microplastics (MPs) are emerging contaminants of concern due to their ubiquitous presence in aquatic environments and their ability to adsorb, transport, and rerelease other contaminants.
